next_experiment: Validate full-frame original/autotuned V43/V63 outputs and exports at unchanged1/.25DN16 gates before adoption, with adequate reserved disk space.
scope: Inference engineering on unchanged mature EMA weights, fixed four512px contexts and IEEE FP32 no AMP/TF32. All four complete RGB contexts pass fixed bounds per checkpoint, independent float64 math.fsum check within1e-15DN. Source/model/DINO/RNG identity and repeated/traced byte equality pass. Traces map every positive GPU activity. Shared-machine separate-process medians are not balanced repeated throughput trials, full-frame or training speed. Sixteen native triplets/24cells viewed; ISO100 is a qualitative reference, not GT. No training extension, SOTA claim or model promotion.
